name: BigBangSwap
fix_description: addLiquidity function (0xba531b6d) has precision loss in LP share calculation. When computing shares = amount * totalSupply / reserve, integer division rounds in favor of the depositor. Attacker loops add/remove liquidity 2880+ times, accumulating rounding profit each cycle. Fix: round down in share calculation (use (amount * totalSupply) / reserve without +1 adjustment), or add minimum deposit threshold.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, repetitive exploit: flash loan a small amount of BUSD, repeatedly create helper contracts, buy BGG, call the vulnerable sellRewardToken function, and sweep profits. It relies on an obvious protocol-specific logic flaw around per-address/accounting abuse rather than complex DeFi mechanics, with minimal routing and no sophisticated state, timing, or cross-protocol reasoning.
